definitions.gloss: resale prohibited; ban on reselling (especially tickets, limited goods, etc. at a markup)
definitions.explanation: resale prohibited; ban on reselling (especially tickets, limited goods, etc. at a markup)

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{転売|てんばい}{禁止|きんし}です。
examples.english: Resale of this ticket is prohibited.

examples.japanese: {転売|てんばい}{禁止|きんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{施行|しこう}→施行：06581_shikou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A law prohibiting resale was enacted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高額|こうがく}→高額：14704_kougaku⟧⟦{転売|てんばい}される→転売する：26847_tenbaisuru⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、{転売|てんばい}{禁止|きんし}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}→強化：00260_kyouka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In response to the problem of popular concert tickets being resold at inflated prices, anti-resale measures were strengthened.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{転売|てんばい}→転売：10558_tenbai⟧ (resale) and ⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (prohibition). Extremely common in modern Japan, appearing on tickets, product packaging, and event websites. The issue of scalping (⟦{転売|てんばい}{屋|や}→転売屋：24325_tenbaiya⟧ — scalper) became prominent enough that Japan enacted a specific anti-scalping law for entertainment tickets in 2019.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転売|てんばい}{禁止|きんし}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ — anti-resale measures
- {転売|てんばい}{禁止|きんし}{法|ほう} — anti-resale law
- ⟦{高額|こうがく}→高額：14704_kougaku⟧⟦{転売|てんばい}→転売：10558_tenbai⟧ — resale at an inflated price
- ⟦{転売|てんばい}→転売：10558_tenbai⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧ — purchasing for the purpose of resale

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{転売|てんばい}→転売：10558_tenbai⟧ — resale (the act itself)
- ダフ⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧ — scalping (older term, from ダフ{屋|や})
- ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦{転売|てんばい}→転売：10558_tenbai⟧ — illegal resale
